en: Rookie
$10,000 and no special rules.
Day Trader
$8,000, starts with Low Fees, maximum leverage +1x.
Value Investor
$12,000, cannot short, long dividends are doubled.
Insider Inu
Knows one rumor a quarter is true, and can publish its opposite.
Once a quarter, on a random day, you learn that tomorrow's rumor is TRUE.
FLIP (once a quarter): publish the opposite instead. When it resolves it is stamped as planted, and nobody learns by whom.
Copilot Cody
Copies another player's bet whenever he likes.
Each day you may COPILOT another player: you place the same bet as them, at the normal odds.
None. Your best skill is picking who to follow.
Double Dan
Sees every bet first, then decides whether to double his own.
None. You read the table instead.
DOUBLE DOWN (once a quarter): after all bets are revealed and before the result, double your own option.
Saving Son
Lets the cash work. Simple and steady.
Your cash earns 0.5% interest every day.
None.
Goldfish Gus
Forgets everything but today. Gets paid for it.
You can't see credibility or the chart, only today's price. Winning options pay +0.3 odds.
None.
Hodl Hana
Never sells. Believes in one stock, loudly.
You start with half your cash in the best stock of the pre-game weeks, bought at its low, and can never sell it. Rumors about its sector pay +0.5 odds.
None.
